5 09-07-2025 Heard the learned counsel for the appellant as well as the learned APP for the State.

2. This appeal has been preferred against the judgment of conviction dated 29.01.2024 and order of sentence dated 31.01.2024 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge- VI cum Special Judge POCSO Rohtas at Sasaram in connection with POCSO Case No. 96 of 2022 arising out of Kochas (Parasnath O.P) P.S. Case No. 292 of 2022 whereby and whereunder the appellant has been convicted for the offences punishable under Section 376 of the I.P.C and sentenced to undergo ten years R.I along with fine of Rs. 30,000/- and in default of payment of fine further to undergo additional Patna High Court CR.

sentences.text: APP (SJ) No.1313 of 2024(5) dt.09-07-2025 imprisonment for six months.
3. While making the prayer for bail and suspension of sentence, learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that victim was major at the time of incident.
The learned trial court held that on the date and time of occurrence, she was aged eighteen years three months.

He further submitted that in her cross-examination she stated that she went to Surat with the appellant according to her own sweet will for the purpose of tour and no one has committed any kind of misdeed with her.

sentences.text: counsel has also submitted that the maximum sentence awarded to the appellant is 10 years R.I. and he has remained under custody for more than one year four months and there is no likelihood of this appeal be taken in near future.
4. On the other hand, the learned APP for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and suspension of sentence.

5. Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances as well as the fact that there is no likelihood of the appeal being taken up for hearing in near future, this Court is inclined to accept the prayer for bail of the appellant.

Accordingly, let the appellant above-named be enlarged on bail during the pendency of this appeal on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.1313 of 2024(5) dt.09-07-2025 amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-VI cum Special Judge POCSO Rohtas at Sasaram in connection with POCSO Case No. 96 of 2022 arising out of Kochas (Parasnath O.P) P.S.
Case No. 292 of 2022.
6.
